functions.name: is_admin
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION kitty_website_private.is_admin()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select auth.uid() is not null and exists (
   select 1 from kitty_website_private.admins a
   join auth.users u on u.id=a.user_id
   join auth.sessions s on s.user_id=u.id
   where a.user_id=auth.uid()
     and s.id=(auth.jwt()->>'session_id')::uuid
     and (u.banned_until is null or u.banned_until<now())
     and (s.not_after is null or s.not_after>now())
 );
$function$

constraints.name: kitty_website_early_access_interests_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((interests <@ ARRAY['KITTY AI'::text, 'KITTY Sentinel'::text, 'LISA AI'::text, 'KITTY CORP updates'::text]) AND ((cardinality(interests) >= 1) AND (cardinality(interests) <= 4))))

constraints.name: published_launch_has_apk
